people.name: Sadiq al-Ahmar
people.extract: Sheikh Sadiq bin Abdullah bin Hussein bin Nasser al-Ahmar was a Yemeni politician and leader of the Hashid tribal federation. He succeeded his father Abdullah ibn Husayn al-Ahmar in these positions after Abdullah's death in 2007. He is best known for his role in the 2011 Yemeni uprising, in which fighters under his command attacked and seized government facilities in the Battle of Sana'a.
highlights: Yemeni politician and leader of Hashid tribal federation.
Known for role in 2011 Yemeni uprising.

people.name: Lonnie Johnson (inventor)
people.extract: Lonnie George Johnson is an American inventor, aerospace engineer, and entrepreneur, best known for inventing the bestselling Super Soaker water gun in 1989. He previously served in the U.S. Air Force and worked at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
highlights: Invented the bestselling Super Soaker water gun.
Worked at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
